instruction: Repair {{entry}}, a POSIX sh script accepting input-file and output-file paths. Input is one unsigned decimal integer (at most nine digits) per nonempty line; blank lines are ignored. Export one TSV row per number: original decimal spelling, tab, value plus {{constant}}, newline. Reject invalid input with exit 2, preserving an existing output byte-for-byte. On success replace output atomically through a same-directory temporary file, preserve existing output mode (new output 0600), and clean all temporary files on error/interruption. Handle spaces and leading dashes in paths. Print no stdout. Reject nonregular or symlink output targets.
